scope: Common tools; each case revision selects its FinShield dependency file.

python.acquisition: Install Python 3.12 or later from the Python distributor. Pass its executable to bootstrap.ps1.

node.acquisition: Install Node.js 24 or later for the existing DSH Web adapter.

dsh.acquisition: Use the DSH version selected by the case suite's Agent profile. Supply dshEntry and dshDesktop in the local recording profile.

chrome.acquisition: Install Chrome and set the chrome executable in the local profile. Record the actual version for a new trial.

ffmpeg.acquisition: Supply a Windows FFmpeg build with these capabilities in the local profile.

desktopTool.acquisition: Supply the Windows virtual-desktop tool expected by the existing adapter.
